lines.t: I asked how to reach them, how to break through the dark
How to carry your fire without catching a spark
But your voice pierced the silence, a sudden decree
Did you think human power could do this for me?
I am just a vessel, a servant in the field
It's your hand alone by which the broken are healed
You told me to stand clear, to stay separate and true
For what does the daylight have to do with the blue?
So I will not kick my foot against the stones

I will not try to fight this battle alone You soften the seeker, you break down the wall My strength is nothing but you are my all I will step back, let your majesty show And I shall go where you sent me to go
You gave us the seeds, told your servants to sow
We did the watering, but you made it grow
I am not the author, I didn't pour out the grace
I'm just a witness to the light in this place
So I will not kick my foot against the stones
I will not try to fight this battle alone
You soften the seeker, you break down the wall
My strength is nothing but you are my all
I will step back, let your majesty show
And I shall go where you send me to call
Why should I try to teach
I teach the blind how to see
Why should I demand them you speak to me?
You are the teacher, the rebuke and the seal
Every heart changes when your power's revealed
And I will not kick my foot against the stones
I will not try to fight this battle alone
You soften the seeker, you break down the wall
My strength is nothing but you are my all
Where you send me
Not by my power
You bring the increase
I will just obey
Thanks for watching!
